# omni_connection (Data Source)

Looks up a database connection by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The connection's unique ID. One of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The connection name. One of `id` or `name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `base_role` (String) The default role for users on this connection.
- `database` (String) The default database or catalog.
- `default_schema` (String) The default schema.
- `dialect` (String) The database dialect.
